Name: Arcade Sign - Reward for beating both Journey of the Prairie King (JOTPK) and Junimo Kart (JK)
Author: MissAnaira
Description:
Gus is so impressed by you completing both Journey of the Prairie King and Junimo Kart, he sends you another arcade sign just like the one in the Stardrop Saloon!

This mod is compatible with i18n translation! Please leave a post or contact me on Discord: MissAnaira
